species.name: Daisy
species.fact: Daisies close their petals at night and open again with the morning sun.

species.name: Tulip
species.fact: A tulip bulb sleeps underground all winter, then blooms as soon as it warms up.

species.name: Bee
species.fact: A bee visits thousands of flowers a day and dances to tell friends where the nectar is.

species.name: Butterfly
species.fact: Butterflies taste with their feet and start life as a hungry little caterpillar.

species.name: Ladybug
species.fact: Ladybugs eat aphids, so gardeners love them. Their spots warn birds: not tasty!

species.name: Turtle
species.fact: Turtles carry their shell like a house and love to bask in the sun on a log.

species.name: Frog
species.fact: Frogs breathe partly through their skin and can jump many times their body length.

species.name: Duck
species.fact: A duck's feathers are waterproof, so it stays dry even after a long swim.

species.name: Koi
species.fact: Koi can live for decades and learn to swim up for snack time.

species.name: Snail
species.fact: A snail glides on a trail of slime and tucks into its shell when it's scared.

species.name: Apple
species.fact: Apple blossoms turn into crunchy apples, a favourite snack of the whole orchard.

species.name: Owl
species.fact: Owls can turn their heads almost all the way around and fly without a sound.

species.name: Hedgehog
species.fact: A hedgehog curls into a prickly ball when it senses danger.

species.name: Mushroom
species.fact: Mushrooms pop up overnight after rain, spreading tiny spores in the air.

species.name: Fox
species.fact: Foxes are clever and quick, with a big fluffy tail that keeps them warm when they sleep.
